title: Postgraduate fellowship DBT credit delayed for September quarter
description: The direct bank transfer for the mandatory M.Tech research stipend has not been credited to Canara Bank account.

statusHistory.remarks: Complaint formally submitted to AICTE Institutional Complaint Monitoring Portal with 15-day statutory SLA.

title: Digital library terminal outages during examination week
description: Over 40 terminals in the central e-library have been disconnected from the institutional proxy since Monday, preventing access to IEEE research papers.

statusHistory.remarks: Complaint formally submitted to AICTE Institutional Complaint Monitoring Portal with 15-day statutory SLA.

title: Unlawful retention of Transfer Certificate after degree completion
description: The administrative department refuses to issue TC and migration certificate despite clearance of all dues.

statusHistory.remarks: Complaint formally submitted to AICTE Institutional Complaint Monitoring Portal with 15-day statutory SLA.
Statutory notice served to COEP Registrar requesting immediate release of Transfer Certificate.
Transfer Certificate and Migration documents released by COEP administration and received by student.

officerNotes.author: Dr. Sunita Deshmukh
officerNotes.note: Spoke directly with Registrar. Verified student has cleared all laboratory and library dues.

resolutionDetails.resolutionSummary: Original TC and Migration certificate formally handed over to complainant on 22 Oct 2026.
resolutionDetails.actionTakenAgainstInstitute: Advisory warning issued regarding non-compliance with AICTE Approval Process Handbook Clause 3.5.

title: Physical intimidation and late-night harassment in Hostel Block B
description: Senior students from 3rd year hostel Wing 4 have been repeatedly calling 1st year students to common rooms past midnight and forcing them to perform humiliating activities under threat of campus isolation. Specific incidents occurred on 14th and 17th October 2026. The hostel warden was informally notified but no written circular or night patrolling was increased.

assignedOfficer.name: Dr. Vivek S. Rathore
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE Headquarters, Nelson Mandela Marg, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi

statusHistory.remarks: Grievance submitted via AICTE National Complaint Monitoring Portal under Anti-Ragging regulations.
Flagged as Critical Priority. Notice sent to Dean of Student Welfare and Chief Proctor demanding immediate CCTV footage preservation and Anti-Ragging Squad report within 48 hours.
Institutional Proctorial Board formed an interim inquiry committee. Two students suspended from hostel pending formal disciplinary hearing scheduled on 24th October.
Hearing committee summoned for inquiry

officerNotes.author: Dr. Vivek S. Rathore
officerNotes.note: Requested local police liaison officer to verify night patrolling compliance near boys hostel perimeter.

officerNotes.author: NRO Liaison Officer
officerNotes.note: Warden statement collected. Complainant identity remains strictly anonymized as per Supreme Court mandate.

title: Mandatory non-refundable uniform and development fee charged in excess of State Fee Regulating Authority (FRA) norms
description: The college accounts section issued a demand notice of ₹28,500 under "Auxiliary Campus Facility & Kit Charges" which is not approved in the official Shikshan Shulka Samiti / FRA fee structure. Students were threatened with debarment from mid-semester exams if payment was not completed by 15th October.

assignedOfficer.name: Smt. Anjali Kulkarni
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE Western Regional Office, Churchgate, Mumbai

statusHistory.remarks: Submitted with attached FRA approved fee slab order.

statusHistory.action: Notice issued to Registrar & Finance Officer
statusHistory.remarks: WRO sought verification of the ₹28,500 challan against the official FRA schedule.

statusHistory.action: Directives issued for Fee Hold & Reversal
statusHistory.remarks: Management instructed that non-tuition ancillary charges cannot be made mandatory or conditioned upon exam admit card clearance.
College issued official circular No. COEP/ACC/2026/89 withdrawing mandatory collection. Excess collected fees refunded to 342 students.

officerNotes.author: Smt. Anjali Kulkarni
officerNotes.note: Audit team cross-checked circular with state FRA portal. Fee item is strictly disallowed.

resolutionDetails.resolutionSummary: College administration has officially withdrawn the unapproved fee demand. Examination hall tickets issued to all affected students without condition.
resolutionDetails.actionTakenAgainstInstitute: Advisory letter placed in institution permanent record file (AICTE-WRO/REG/2026/410).
resolutionDetails.signedBy: Dr. Ramesh Unnikrishnan, Advisor (Approval Bureau), AICTE

title: Withholding of original B.Tech degree certificates and denial of Migration Certificate upon course withdrawal
description: I qualified for a public sector enterprise fellowship and submitted my withdrawal application on 2nd October within permissible AICTE timeline. The college administration refuses to return original 10th, 12th, and B.Tech marks sheets unless entire remaining 2nd year course fee is deposited.

statusHistory.remarks: Original documents retention violation reported under AICTE Approval Process Handbook Clause 3.5.
Direct show-cause issued to Registrar citing penalty clauses of AICTE Act regarding withholding of educational credentials.
Institute confirmed receipt of notice and called student for handover of documents on 23rd October 2026.

officerNotes.author: Shri Pankaj Kumar
officerNotes.note: Registrar verbally agreed that original certificates must not be retained under any pretext. Following up for signed clearance receipt.

institutionName: Jadavpur University - Faculty of Engg & Tech
title: Severe equipment downtime in High Voltage & Power Systems Laboratory affecting practical exams
description: Over 60% of oscilloscopes, test benches, and safety isolation transformers in the High Voltage laboratory are non-functional since August 2026. Multiple batches are forced to share single setups, preventing completion of required AICTE model curriculum practical experiments.

assignedOfficer.name: Dr. Debabrata Sengupta
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE Eastern Regional Office, LB Block, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata

statusHistory.remarks: New grievance submitted. Awaiting initial scrutiny by ERO technical inspection desk.

title: Sanctioned faculty shortfall and substitution of core theory subjects with ad-hoc guest lecturers without qualifications
description: Department has only 2 regular assistant professors against an AICTE sanctioned Cadre Ratio requirement of 1:15 (minimum 8 full-time teachers). Complex core subjects like Database Engineering and Statistical AI are taught intermittently by fresh graduates with no research background.

assignedOfficer.name: Dr. Manjunath Swamy
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE South-Western Regional Office, Palace Road, Bengaluru

statusHistory.remarks: Filed regarding faculty deficiency standards.
Institution requested to submit current faculty roster with biometric attendance records.
Institution failed to provide satisfactory faculty recruitment roadmap within mandated 10 working days. Case referred to AICTE Standing Hearing Committee.

officerNotes.author: Dr. Manjunath Swamy
officerNotes.note: Recommended for physical expert committee inspection in November cycle. Deficit exceeds 40%.

title: Delay in monthly AICTE PG Scholarship (GATE) verification and biometric attendance upload by institute
description: GATE qualified PG students in the VLSI department have not received monthly stipends of ₹12,400 for August and September 2026 because the institute scholarship nodal officer did not approve student attendance rosters on the AICTE DBT Portal within the monthly deadline.

assignedOfficer.name: Shri R. Balachandran
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE Southern Regional Office, Shastri Bhavan, Chennai

statusHistory.remarks: Reported delay in institute-level DBT portal verification.

statusHistory.action: System Alert Sent to College Nodal Officer
statusHistory.remarks: Automated directive issued to Principal to clear backlog of attendance approvals within 72 hours.

officerNotes.author: Shri R. Balachandran
officerNotes.note: College nodal officer confirmed server syncing glitch on their biometric machine. Reconciliation underway.

title: Refusal to permit re-evaluation of End-Semester Structural Analysis paper as per UGC/AICTE transparency rules
description: Controller of Examinations office denied application for scanned copy of answer script and third-party re-evaluation, stating internal autonomous regulation overrides AICTE student grievance evaluation mandates.

assignedOfficer.name: Dr. K. Srinivas Reddy
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE South-Central Regional Office, Masab Tank, Hyderabad

statusHistory.remarks: Exam evaluation transparency violation cited.
CBIT instructed to adhere to transparent re-evaluation guidelines as affirmed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
Scanned script provided to student; independent re-evaluation resulted in upward revision of grade from C to B+.

resolutionDetails.resolutionSummary: Answer script supplied to complainant. Independent faculty re-evaluation concluded with 11 marks increment, revised mark sheet dispatched.
resolutionDetails.actionTakenAgainstInstitute: Institution advised to update autonomous examination bylaws in alignment with AICTE Model Regulations.
resolutionDetails.signedBy: Dr. K. Srinivas Reddy, Regional Officer

institutionName: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology
title: Non-functional SC/ST/OBC and Minority Grievance Cell and lack of ombudsperson accessibility
description: Institution has not displayed the mandatory Ombudsperson contact information on its website or student notice boards. Several complaints submitted to the internal cell have remained unacknowledged for over 45 days.

assignedOfficer.name: Dr. M. S. Ghuman
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE North-Western Regional Office, Sector 36-A, Chandigarh

statusHistory.remarks: Statutory compliance check pending with NWRO.

title: Non-functional VLSI design laboratory, expired software licenses, and unventilated chemical store
description: The core VLSI CAD lab has 45 work stations but only 8 active license keys for Synopsys and Cadence tools, forcing 5-6 students per terminal during practical sessions. Additionally, the chemistry building basement laboratory has zero mechanical exhaust ventilation, creating chemical fumes during lab hours.

assignedOfficer.name: Dr. K. Sundararajan
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE Southern Regional Office, Shastri Bhawan, Chennai

statusHistory.remarks: Infrastructure deficit complaint filed under AICTE Norms & Standards Regulations.
AICTE Southern Regional Office issued formal notice demanding lab equipment ledger and AMC license agreements within 7 working days.

statusHistory.action: Expert Visiting Committee (EVC) Physical Audit Scheduled
statusHistory.remarks: Two-member expert visiting committee appointed to conduct unannounced verification of computing ratios and hazardous exhaust systems.

officerNotes.author: Dr. K. Sundararajan
officerNotes.note: AICTE Approval Process Handbook mandates 1:1 student-to-system ratio during laboratory exams.

title: Arbitrary withholding of 6th semester end-term results and improper moderation in Structural Mechanics
description: Over 68 students who appeared in the May-June 2026 supplementary and regular examinations had their marks cards withheld without explanation. The controller of examinations office has refused to grant photocopies of evaluated answer scripts or process re-evaluation applications despite statutory right under RTI & AICTE Evaluation Guidelines.

assignedOfficer.name: Prof. Debabrata Goswami
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE Eastern Regional Office, LB Block, Sector-III, Kolkata

statusHistory.remarks: Exam evaluation dispute lodged before regional directorate.

statusHistory.action: Show Cause Issued to Controller of Examinations
statusHistory.remarks: Notice issued requiring University Examination Board to file affidavit regarding withholding cause.

statusHistory.action: Escalated to AICTE Standing Appellate Committee (SAC)
statusHistory.remarks: Statutory 15-day institutional response period lapsed without compliance. File escalated to AICTE Member Secretary for regulatory penalty proceedings.

officerNotes.author: Prof. Debabrata Goswami
officerNotes.note: University administration cited staff vacancy. Not an acceptable ground to withhold student careers or placement eligibility.

title: Refusal to refund full tuition fee upon seat cancellation prior to AICTE national cut-off date
description: Candidate cancelled provisional admission on 12th September 2026 (two weeks prior to AICTE national admission closure deadline) after securing admission in a premier NIT. The institute deducted ₹65,000 citing administrative overheads, directly violating AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH) rules that restrict maximum deduction to ₹1,000.

statusHistory.remarks: Admission fee refund dispute lodged under APH Chapter VII regulations.
Cancellation email receipt confirmed submitted before cut-off. Notice issued to Registrar to remit refund within 7 working days.

institutionName: Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology (MNNIT Allahabad)
title: Non-forwarding of Pragati / Saksham scholarship institute verification portal approval for SC/ST scholars
description: The college scholarship nodal desk failed to verify and forward 42 eligible SC/ST and girl student scholarship applications on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) before the regional deadline of 30th September 2026, risking cancellation of full-year tuition scholarship grants.

statusHistory.remarks: DBT scholarship delay complaint submitted.
AICTE central IT cell reopened verification window for institute and issued notice to Director MNNIT.
All 42 pending applications authenticated on NSP. PFMS payment advice generated for direct bank transfer.

officerNotes.author: Dr. Vivek S. Rathore
officerNotes.note: Institute compliance officer confirmed portal approval status. Complainant confirmed receipt of SMS confirmation.

resolutionDetails.resolutionSummary: Institutional verification completed under special window; PFMS treasury release initiated to student Aadhaar-seeded accounts.
resolutionDetails.actionTakenAgainstInstitute: Institutional Nodal Officer counselled regarding timely adherence to national scholarship schedules.
resolutionDetails.signedBy: Dr. Mamta Rani Agarwal, Advisor (Student Development Cell), AICTE

title: Severe shortage of approved Cadre Ratio faculty and conduct of core AI courses by non-technical lab assistants
description: The Department of Electronics has failed to recruit full-time qualified assistant professors following retirements. 3 core subjects (Embedded Systems, Machine Learning for Signal Processing, and Antenna Design) are being handled by temporary contract assistants with no postgraduate research credentials.

statusHistory.remarks: Faculty deficiency complaint submitted with official department timetable.

title: Non-constitution of Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) and denial of access to Equal Opportunity Cell
description: Despite repeated representations by postgraduate researchers regarding laboratory access hours and stipend disbursement delays, the institute has not convened the statutory Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) mandated under AICTE Regulations 2019.

statusHistory.remarks: Statutory SGRC compliance grievance registered.
Notice dispatched to Registrar to furnish notification order regarding SGRC constitution and designated Ombudsperson details.

officerNotes.author: Dr. Vivek S. Rathore
officerNotes.note: AICTE Gazette Notification 2019 requires all AICTE approved institutions to publish SGRC members on official website.

institutionName: Anna University (College of Engineering Guindy), Chennai
title: Dysfunctional emergency eyewash stations and outdated fume exhaust system in chemical research block
description: The chemical research laboratory in the Department of Polymer Engineering has non-operational emergency safety eyewash stations and the central fume exhaust system has been dysfunctional for over 6 weeks. Organic vapors accumulate during reaction distillations, creating hazardous health conditions contrary to mandatory AICTE Safety Handbook norms.

assignedOfficer.name: Dr. K. Sundararajan
assignedOfficer.office: AICTE Southern Regional Office, Shastri Bhawan, Chennai

statusHistory.remarks: Laboratory safety and environmental compliance grievance submitted.

statusHistory.action: Directives Issued to Head of Department
statusHistory.remarks: Notice issued to Registrar and HOD Chemical Engineering to execute emergency HVAC duct repair and certify eyewash pressure within 5 days.

officerNotes.author: Dr. K. Sundararajan
officerNotes.note: AICTE Approval Process Handbook Appendix 6 mandates functioning safety eyewash and fire dampeners in all chemical laboratories.
